Hello, I am a 70-year-old patient with osteoarthritis. I have been experiencing joint pain, stiffness, and locomotor restriction. The pain is usually related to activity and resolves with rest. In some cases, the pain is more continuous and affects my daily activities, eventually causing severe limitations in function. I have been experiencing bony swelling and joint deformity, which sometimes causes my joint to give way or buckle, a sign of muscle weakness. Joint pain is usually the first symptom and is often related to physical activity. It may be sudden in onset or develop gradually over time. Some patients may also experience stiffness in the affected joints, which can make it difficult to move around in the morning or after a period of inactivity.
